notes.title: Update Version 1.5 "Heavens Alteration"
notes.content:
"Link: The Unleashed Nexus" has been updated!
New version "1.5 Heavens Alteration" adds...

- Thruster Alternative (More easier control)
- HAVEN Alteration System (After 10miss, support system helps you)
- 1 additional stage "Revived Helix: 2nd Invasion Route Exploration"


And 3 new musics are added to Game and OST.
